basic_details.job_title: NIHFW Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Accountant, Accounts Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Health & Family Welfare (NIHFW), New Delhi, an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, is filling 9 posts: 2 Accounts Officer, 5 Accountant and 2 Programmer. All posts are on deputation, except the Programmer posts, which go to direct recruitment if no suitable deputationist is available. Applications go offline, through proper channel, to The Dy. Director (Admin.), NIHFW, New Delhi. They must be received within 45 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.

important_dates.application_start_date: From the date of publishing on Institute's Website www.nihfw.ac.in

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Health and Family Welfare is an autonomous institute funded by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, located at Baba Gangnath Marg, Munirka, New Delhi-110067. In its own words, it is an apex Technical Institute for promoting Health and Family Welfare Programmes in the country through Education and Training, Research and Evaluation, Consultancy, Advisory and Specialized Services.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Use Annexure-I (For Group-B Deputation post) for Accounts Officer, Accountant and Programmer on deputation. Use Annexure-II (For Group B Direct Post) for Programmer under direct recruitment. Affix a recent passport size photograph and fill in all the columns except those that do not apply. Attach attested copies of ACRs/APAR for the last five years, plus self-attested copies of proof of age/date of birth, educational qualifications, experience certificates and other relevant documents. Programmer direct recruitment applicants attach a Demand Draft/Indian Postal Order of Rs. 300/- in favour of Director, NIHFW, payable at New Delhi, and give its details (post office/bank, number and date, amount) on the form. Have the forwarding office fill in the certificate at the bottom of the proforma. It confirms that the official is clear from the vigilance point of view and that no disciplinary case is pending or contemplated. Superscribe the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ____" (write the post name). Make sure the application reaches the Institute on or before the last date. Applications received after the prescribed last date shall not be entertained. Applications sent by FAX or e-mail will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected. NIHFW is not responsible for any delay, loss or non-receipt of applications sent through post/courier.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of ACRs/APAR for the last five years Self-attested copies of proof of age/date of birth Self-attested copies of educational qualifications Experience certificates and other relevant documents Category certificate (the form states that the certificate must be enclosed) Recent passport size photograph affixed on the form Demand Draft/IPO of Rs. 300/- (Programmer direct recruitment only) Certificate by Head of Department/Organization, for candidates working in Govt./Semi Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies. It certifies no objection, verified particulars, no pending or contemplated disciplinary proceedings, integrity, and the date the application was submitted for onward transmission to NIHFW.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Institute, at its discretion, may conduct an Interview/Written Test for these posts to select candidates on the basis of merit. The decision of the Director, NIHFW shall be final. Applicants appear for the Interview/written test at their own expenses. Original degrees/certificates/proof of date of birth must be produced at the time of the Interview/final selection. Candidates working in Govt./Semi Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from the competent authority at the time of Documents Verification/Final Selection. At Documents Verification, candidates must give details of any criminal case pending against them. NIHFW may verify police records and reserves the right to deny appointment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIHFW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 2 Accounts Officer, 5 Accountant and 2 Programmer, all in the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIHFW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach NIHFW within 45 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News. Applications received after the last date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NIHFW Programmer post?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree in Computer Applications / Information Technology / Computer Science, or B.E./B.Tec. in Computer Engineering / Computer Science / Computer Technology / Computer Science & Engineering / Information Technology. Candidates also need two years' experience in Web Development / Management in a Government Office/PSU/Autonomous Body/Statutory Body or any recognized Institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NIHFW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For deputation, the limit is not more than 56 years as on closing date for all three posts. Programmer direct recruits must be not exceeding 30 years, with relaxations for Government servants, NIHFW staff and SC/ST and other categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for NIHFW Accounts Officer, Accountant and Programmer?
faq.answer: Accounts Officer and Programmer are at Pay Matrix Level 7 (Rs. 44,900 - Rs. 1,42,400/-). Accountant is at Pay Matrix Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400/-).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NIHFW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Nil for Accounts Officer, Accountant and Programmer on deputation. Programmer direct recruitment applicants pay Rs. 300/- by DD/IPO in favour of Director, NIHFW, payable at New Delhi. SC, ST, Physically Handicapped, Female and Departmental candidates pay no fee.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for NIHFW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in Annexure-I (deputation) or Annexure-II (Programmer direct recruitment) and attach the documents. Send it through proper channel to The Dy. Director (Admin.), NIHFW, Baba Gang Nath Marg, Munirka, New Delhi – 110067, with the envelope superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ____".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NIHFW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Institute, at its discretion, may conduct an Interview/Written Test to select candidates on the basis of merit. The Director, NIHFW's decision is final.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply for the NIHFW Programmer post by direct recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, using Annexure-II. However, direct recruitment applications will be considered only if no suitable candidate is available on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the deputation period at NIHFW?
faq.answer: The period of deputation, including any immediately preceding deputation in another ex-cadre post, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.
